headline: CIN @ NYY matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CIN 3.41 at NYY 4.77, with a projected total of 8.18. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward NYY: CIN moved +0.03 runs while NYY moved +0.44, changing the projected margin by -0.41 runs. The projected total climbed +0.59, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -13.9%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Cam Schlittler has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Paul Goldschmidt, Cody Bellinger, Noelvi Marte, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Spencer Steer, Max Schuemann because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
